festival_crowds: During major religious festivals like Hanuman Jayanti and Sri Rama Navami, the influx of thousands of devotees causes a massive spike in wait times. The overall average waiting time combining all major festivals sits at 2 to 4 hours in the general line.
tips: Visit between 11:00 AM and 04:00 PM on weekdays (Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri) for immediate, crowd-free darshan.
On Tuesdays and Saturdays, arrive early before 05:30 AM or visit during mid-afternoon (01:00 PM - 03:30 PM) to avoid 1+ hour long queues.
Special queue tickets (Sheegra Darshan) are available near the entrance to bypass long general lines during peak hours.
Avoid carrying heavy bags or electronic items during festival days to speed up security checks.

daily_weekly_crowd_breakdown.description: The temple grounds remain very serene and calm. You can complete your darshan smoothly within 10 to 20 minutes.
Families from across Hyderabad visit on weekends. Waiting times average 30 to 45 minutes, peaking during morning and evening aarti hours.

These are the signature holy days for Lord Hanuman. Devotees flock heavily to offer special rituals like Tamalapaku Puja (betel leaf offerings). Expect general darshan queues to take 45 minutes to 1.5 hours.
